'''Aaron Cummings''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[May 2000 Milwaukee tournament]] on 6 May 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Southtown Court (starting Crossfire)]] and Speeder M&T (starting Obi's Hut, Careful Planning), according to Steve Kuperman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d675">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-milwaukee-wisconsion-5-6-2000d675/ milwaukee-wisconsion-5-6-2000], DeckTech (Steve "Crazy Hermit" Kuperman, 6 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-06-milwaukee-wisconsion-5-6-2000d675/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
